meaning_vi: sự phát triển trí tuệ

examples.en: A well-rounded curriculum supports intellectual growth by exposing students to a wide range of subjects.

title: leadership capabilities
meaning_vi: năng lực lãnh đạo

examples.en: Taking charge of a group project allows students to develop leadership capabilities early in their academic life.

title: limits problem-solving experience
meaning_vi: hạn chế kinh nghiệm giải quyết vấn đề

examples.en: Relying solely on textbook exercises limits problem-solving experience compared with real-world projects.

title: personal accountability
meaning_vi: trách nhiệm cá nhân

examples.en: Independent assignments teach personal accountability, since students alone are responsible for meeting deadlines.

title: problem-solving abilities
meaning_vi: khả năng giải quyết vấn đề

examples.en: Collaborative assignments sharpen students' problem-solving abilities by exposing them to different perspectives.

title: problem-solving competence
meaning_vi: năng lực giải quyết vấn đề

examples.en: Hands-on laboratory work is one of the most effective ways to build problem-solving competence in young scientists.

title: real-time communication and teamwork
meaning_vi: giao tiếp và làm việc nhóm theo thời gian thực

examples.en: Face-to-face seminars give students far more opportunities for real-time communication and teamwork than online courses do.

title: strategic planning skills
meaning_vi: kỹ năng lập kế hoạch chiến lược

examples.en: Running a student club can help young people develop strategic planning skills long before they enter the workforce.

title: well-rounded individuals
meaning_vi: những cá nhân phát triển toàn diện

examples.en: Schools that combine academic study with sport and the arts are more likely to produce well-rounded individuals.

title: impose their personal moral perspectives
meaning_vi: áp đặt quan điểm đạo đức cá nhân

examples.en: If teachers impose their personal moral perspectives on students, families with different beliefs may feel their values are being undermined.

title: positively influence classroom discipline
meaning_vi: tác động tích cực đến kỷ luật lớp học

examples.en: A teacher who models patience and fairness can positively influence classroom discipline without resorting to punishment.

title: responsible civic behavior
meaning_vi: hành vi công dân có trách nhiệm

examples.en: Citizenship lessons in secondary school are designed to instil responsible civic behavior in young people.

title: the risk of bias and inconsistency
term: the risk of bias and inconsistency
meaning_vi: nguy cơ thiên vị và thiếu nhất quán

examples.en: Relying solely on individual teachers to teach morality carries the risk of bias and inconsistency across classrooms.

title: accurately assess risks
meaning_vi: đánh giá rủi ro một cách chính xác

examples.en: Young children often cannot accurately assess risks, which is why adult guidance remains crucial in their early years.

title: encounter dangerous or distressing outcomes
meaning_vi: gặp phải những kết quả nguy hiểm hoặc đáng lo ngại

examples.en: Without proper guidance, children may encounter dangerous or distressing outcomes that could have been easily prevented.

title: irreversible consequences
meaning_vi: hậu quả không thể đảo ngược

examples.en: Parents should intervene only when a child's decision could lead to irreversible consequences, such as serious injury.

title: self-reflection
meaning_vi: sự tự phản tỉnh, nhìn nhận lại bản thân

examples.en: Keeping a learning journal encourages self-reflection, helping students identify their own strengths and weaknesses.

title: cultivating essential life skills
meaning_vi: trau dồi các kỹ năng sống thiết yếu

examples.en: Schools should devote more time to cultivating essential life skills, such as budgeting and cooking.

title: emotional support
meaning_vi: hỗ trợ tinh thần

examples.en: A good teacher offers emotional support to students who are struggling to adjust to a new school.

title: engage in discussions or teamwork
meaning_vi: tham gia thảo luận hoặc làm việc nhóm

examples.en: Students who study entirely alone rarely engage in discussions or teamwork, which can hold them back later in their careers.

title: foster confidence and collaboration
meaning_vi: nuôi dưỡng sự tự tin và hợp tác

examples.en: Team sports in schools foster confidence and collaboration in ways that individual study rarely can.

title: peer support network
meaning_vi: mạng lưới hỗ trợ từ bạn bè

examples.en: First-year university students who join a peer support network are less likely to drop out of their course.

title: reconciling differing viewpoints
meaning_vi: dung hòa những quan điểm khác nhau

examples.en: Group assignments teach students the art of reconciling differing viewpoints before a deadline.

title: repeated experiences of decision-making
meaning_vi: những trải nghiệm ra quyết định lặp đi lặp lại

examples.en: Repeated experiences of decision-making, even in small matters, gradually build a child's confidence and independence.

title: distinguishing right from wrong
meaning_vi: phân biệt đúng sai

examples.en: Teachers play a key role in distinguishing right from wrong for students who spend most of their day at school.

title: integrate ethics or character education programs
term: integrate ethics or character education programs
meaning_vi: lồng ghép các chương trình giáo dục đạo đức hoặc nhân cách

examples.en: Many schools now integrate ethics or character education programs into their weekly timetable alongside core subjects.

title: reinforcing ethical behavior
meaning_vi: củng cố hành vi đạo đức

examples.en: Reinforcing ethical behavior through daily classroom routines is often more effective than a single lesson on morality.

title: adult supervision
meaning_vi: sự giám sát của người lớn

examples.en: Adult supervision is essential when young children are learning to use sharp tools or cross busy streets.

title: make minor mistakes
meaning_vi: mắc những lỗi nhỏ

examples.en: Children who are allowed to make minor mistakes tend to develop stronger problem-solving skills later in life.

title: protect children from harm
meaning_vi: bảo vệ trẻ em khỏi nguy hiểm

examples.en: Schools have a duty to protect children from harm while still allowing them room to explore and experiment.

title: receives a mild penalty
meaning_vi: nhận một hình phạt nhẹ

examples.en: When a student receives a mild penalty for a small error, they are more likely to remember the lesson without feeling discouraged.
